name: hm.technical
description: Score a technical answer for a hiring-manager or technical-builder round: would it survive a follow-up probe, and does it distinguish what the candidate built from what they directed.

built_vs_directed.instructions: What the answer claims about the candidate's own role

criteria.built_it: Personally wrote or configured the working system

survives_probe.instructions: A skeptical engineer asking 'how exactly' twice would get concrete answers, not generalities

tradeoff_named.instructions: The answer names a design trade-off and why it was chosen

overclaim.instructions: The answer implies deeper personal technical work than the evidence in it supports

rules.reason: overclaim -- will be caught on the probe; say what you directed

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
